Estamos comprometidos em um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e inclusivo, onde cada funcionário é valorizado e respeitado. Se você é motivado, com habilidades analíticas e paixão pela moda, envie seu currículo para fazer parte da CNS Calçados e Acessórios.

Nosso foco é garantir que a tecnologia esteja sempre alinhada com as melhores práticas e tendências do mercado, diferenciando-nos estrategicamente dos concorrentes. Estamos comprometidos em melhorar continuamente nossos processos e produtos para fornecer um suporte técnico de excelência que aumente a competitividade da Minerva Foods.

As soluções desenvolvidas pela nossa equipe impactam diretamente o EBITDA da empresa, garantindo que as decisões estratégicas e operacionais sejam fundamentadas em sistemas confiáveis e inovadores. Mantemos um diálogo contínuo com a camada executiva e estamos engajados em promover mudanças que aperfeiçoem nossa cultura e processos internos. Através de nossa dedicação à excelência em desenvolvimento de software, direcionamos a Minerva Foods para um futuro tecnicamente avançado e operacionalmente eficiente.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Participação de projetos transversais às diretorias, atuando no ciclo completo de seu desenvolvimento: identificação de oportunidade, definição de escopo, idealização de solução, acompanhamento e report do andamento do projeto, validação de solução proposta, capacitação de usuários e suporte para dúvidas do produto desenvolvido;
  • Ser capaz de questionar e argumentar de forma coerente e construtiva com equipes clientes (Analistas, Coordenadores e Gestores) para contribuir na definição do escopo de projetos de TI. Traduzir as necessidades de negócio em soluções tecnológicas de desenvolvimento de sistemas, considerando as melhores práticas em Engenharia de Software, Arquitetura de Sistemas e Desenvolvimento Ágil. Apresentar, de maneira clara e recorrente, o progresso e os resultados dos projetos em andamento;
  • Possuir conhecimento dos métodos e processos da companhia de maneira a identificar gargalos e oportunidades em outras áreas e defender de maneira sólida, a necessidade do desenvolvimento de novos projetos ou produtos de TI;

title: Consultor de Sucesso do Cliente II
description:
O isaac é a maior plataforma de soluções financeiras feita para escolas. Impulsionamos as instituições oferecendo receita garantida e proporcionando mais flexibilidade de pagamento para as famílias.

Nosso objetivo é facilitar a gestão financeira, acabando com a dor de cabeça e permitindo que a escola consiga focar na missão de educar , dedicando mais tempo e recursos para tirar os planos do papel.

Nos últimos 4 anos, já ajudamos mais de 2.000 escolas, garantimos mais de R$5bi em mensalidades garantidas, e ajudamos a aumentar em 9% o número de matrículas em nossas escolas parceiras.

A cultura do isaac incentiva a autonomia, a mão na massa, o trabalho em equipe e o uso de dados para construir soluções inovadoras.

Temos muito para construir e transformar na Educação brasileira, e você pode fazer parte dessa revolução, vivenciando o impacto do seu trabalho na sociedade!

Vem com a gente?

Activesoft é referência nacional em soluções de gestão e tecnologia para escolas, oferecendo um ERP completo que otimiza a eficiência operacional e financeira das instituições de ensino. ClassApp , por sua vez, nasceu com o propósito de transformar a educação por meio de um relacionamento mais próximo entre escolas e famílias e, hoje, impacta mais de 1.300 escolas e 1 milhão de usuários , consolidando-se como líder no segmento. Já o isaac atua como parceiro financeiro das escolas, trazendo previsibilidade de caixa, liquidez imediata e soluções que fortalecem a sustentabilidade das instituições de ensino.

Juntas, essas soluções compõem a vertical de Finanças & Gestão da Arco Educação , unindo eficiência operacional, inovação tecnológica, proximidade no relacionamento escolar e saúde financeira para impulsionar o sucesso das instituições em todo o país.

Estamos em busca de Consultores de Customer Success , que serão responsáveis por atuar diretamente com escolas de diferentes perfis, conduzindo relacionamentos consultivos de alto impacto. Esses profissionais terão como missão apoiar na adoção das nossas soluções, impulsionar a expansão de oportunidades e garantir a retenção dos clientes, sempre com foco em resultados e geração de valor.

No dia a dia você irá:

  • Gestão de Relacionamento atuando como ponto de contato principal com os clientes, monitorando o Health Score e agindo proativamente para otimizar indicadores de sucesso;
  • Retenção e Fidelização desenvolvendo estratégias para engajar continuamente os clientes e reforçar o valor das soluções oferecidas;
  • Upsell e Cross-Sell explorando oportunidades de expansão e promovendo o uso de novas funcionalidades e serviços complementares.
  • Implantação e Onboarding acompanhando e orientando clientes durante a implantação inicial das soluções, garantindo uma integração fluida e bem-sucedida;
  • Churn e Reversão detectando sinais de insatisfação, atuando rapidamente na solução de problemas e conduzindo negociações para retenção.

Para participar do nosso processo você precisa ter:

  • Experiência em Customer Success, atuando com grandes contas em operações de ciclo longo.
  • Visão analítica e tomada de decisão orientada por indicadores como NPS, churn e expansão de receita.
  • Atuação que vá além da gestão de carteira, contribuindo para a estruturação da operação de CS.
  • Gestão ativa de clientes, com análise crítica de dados e KPIs.
  • Experiência com produtos complexos (SaaS ou sistemas com múltiplos módulos).
  • Vivência em estratégias de expansão, retenção e geração de valor, com viés comercial.
  • Capacidade técnica ou visão clara de priorização e escalabilidade dentro da operação.
  • Auxílio alimentação e/ou refeição (Flash benefícios - R$40,50/dia útil);
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico Sulamérica sem mensalidade e com coparticipação para o colaborador;
  • Cuidado com a saúde física para você e seus dependentes: parceria com a Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Incentivo à educação - parcerias com diversas instituições de ensino;
  • ArcoLab - plataforma de educação corporativa.

#MaisDiversidade

Acreditamos que em um ambiente diverso e inclusivo nossas pessoas serão mais felizes, engajadas e com mais chances de atingir o seu máximo potencial . Por isso, aqui na Activesoft - uma empresa do Grupo Arco Educação, respeitamos e valorizamos a igualdade de direito, reconhecemos as singularidades e acreditamos que todas as pessoas podem contribuir para o nosso propósito.

description:
Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote. We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.

If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

We are looking for a detail-oriented, customer-obsessed Benefits Associate, Operations to join our growing Benefits Operations team. This role is pivotal in supporting the day-to-day delivery of employee benefits programs across multiple countries. As a Benefits Coordinator, you will provide administrative and operational support to ensure our employees and clients enjoy a seamless, informed, and positive benefits experience.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with early experience in HR or benefits administration who is looking to grow in a global, mission-driven organization.

What you bring

  • Experienced in employee benefits, HR operations, or a similar administrative role.
  • Strong customer service skills with clear written and verbal communication.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to handle high-volume tasks accurately.
  • Solid organizational and time management skills; able to meet deadlines and shift priorities.
  • Comfortable working on multiple tools like Zendesk, Notion, Slack, and Google Workspace.
  • Ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.
  • Empathetic and professional when interacting with employees and clients.
  • Solution-oriented and eager to improve processes and service delivery.
  • Team player with a collaborative mindset and openness to feedback.

Key responsibilities

  • Respond to employee and client queries related to benefits via Zendesk and email.
  • Deliver clear, empathetic, and informative support across topics like plan details, enrollment, claims, and billing.
  • Escalate complex issues appropriately and collaborate with Benefits Specialists to ensure resolution.
  • Accurately handle benefits data: validation, updates, and preparation for reporting.
  • Support enrollment and changes (e.g. new joiners, life events, terminations) in both internal and external benefits systems.
  • Assist with invoice audits and data checks, collaborating with the Accounting team to support accurate payment processing.
  • Maintain invoice tracking datasets accurately on a monthly basis.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with teams like Payroll, Legal, Lifecycle, and Finance, and ask for support when needed.
  • Support regular audits and data quality reviews across systems.
  • Track and escalate exceptions or inaccuracies, working with the Quality Analyst and Benefits Specialists.
  • Maintain internal documentation (in Notion or other tools) to reflect updates and recurring learnings.
  • Suggest improvements to benefits FAQs or support articles to enhance clarity for internal or external users.
  • Be an internal and external champion of Remote's values and Benefits team's goals.

Practicals

  • You'll report to: Manager, Benefits Operations

Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We aim to pay above in-location rates and support global talent-hiring. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.

We foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. All compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis.

The annual salary range for this full-time position is

$26,100 - $58,700 USD

Remote is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and identities, and we prioritize a sense of belonging.

How you’ll plan your day (and life)

We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at remote.com/async.

You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

If that sounds like something you want, apply now!

How to apply

  • Please fill out the form below and upload your CV in PDF format.
  • Submit your application and CV in English, as this is the standardised language we use at Remote.
  • If you don’t have an up to date CV but you are still interested, you may add a LinkedIn profile.

Remote is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants from all ethnicities, genders, sexual orientations, ages, abilities, and backgrounds to apply. We are open to accommodations during the interview process upon request.

A CPFL Energia está há 110 anos no setor elétrico e atua nos segmentos de distribuição, geração, transmissão, comercialização e serviços. Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, estatal chinesa que é a terceira maior organização empresarial do mundo e a maior empresa de energia elétrica, atendendo 88% do território chinês.

Overview

We are hiring multiple Data Scientists across LATAM to join the Microsoft 365 team. These are remote positions, allowing you to work from home. As part of our team, you will help shape one of Microsoft’s fastest-growing cloud services. Your work will directly impact Copilot, enabling personalized, context-aware experiences that empower millions of users across Microsoft 365.

Do you want to collaborate closely with software engineers, product managers, and researchers to design, implement, and evaluate models and algorithms that continuously adapt and improve based on user interactions and feedback? Do you want to leverage advanced machine learning and information retrieval to predict and optimize memory content selection, representation, and lifecycle management?

You will work at the forefront of applied AI and machine learning, shaping the future of intelligent productivity tools. You will contribute to a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and experimentation.

The Substrate Core Substrate team powers the infrastructure that underpins Microsoft 365’s most critical services and Copilot. We are a high-impact, forward-looking team focused on building intelligent, scalable, and cost-efficient platforms that enable Microsoft to deliver world-class productivity experiences to billions of users. Our mission is to drive operational excellence and innovation across the M365 fleet by leveraging AI, automation, and deep platform integration.

Your core mission will be to deliver exciting innovation in Microsoft Copilot. Microsoft Copilot is revolutionizing how people work and have created an unprecedented opportunity to advance the state-of-the-art in a way that benefits millions of people.

Responsibilities

We are seeking candidates with research skills and the desire to pursue the cutting edge in model development that pushes technological boundaries. We are looking for candidates with interest and experience in language model training, large language model evaluation, and quality assessment. In particular we would like a candidate that has a passion for understanding what makes an AI solution work and how to measure its performance.

We are looking for candidates who are creative, self-driven, curious, people-oriented and comfortable defining a path through ambiguity towards high-level goals. The successful applicants will collaborate closely with people across Microsoft’s product teams and Microsoft Research to see their ideas realized in products and services that are used worldwide, as well as to contribute back to the scientific community and beyond (e.g. via presentations, publications, media interviews, and similar). Come to define, design, and deliver what enterprise cloud productivity means.

As a Data Scientist , you will help transform how Copilot features are evaluated and improved. Your team will deliver end-to-end experimentation, evaluation, and insights to Copilot engineers, PMs, and fellow scientists. You’ll work on the data generation platform that creates algorithms and ML pipelines for simulating user actions and datasets that reflect real-world usage and user preferences and develop metrics that go beyond accuracy – capturing nuance, intent, and satisfaction. You’ll work on scalable pipelines that support offline evaluations for Copilot Search, BizChat, Connectors, and Agents (DAs). This opportunity will allow you to dive deep into Copilot technologies, shape how AI quality is measured at scale, build critical skills in the AI-era, and rapidly grow your career.

By applying to this position, you will be considered for multiple similar positions within our organization for an invitation-only virtual interview day. Position specifics, including hiring team, location, and position details, will be determined following the interview process.

Responsibilities (detailed)

  • Develop and evaluate ML models using prepared datasets, customer feedback, and novel training/fine-tuning algorithms for language models.

  • Drive customer-centric solutions by aligning with business goals and managing stakeholder expectations.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to define success metrics and improve AI quality at scale.
  • Lead research projects that yield new algorithms, tools, or insights solving open problems.
  • Analyze evaluation outputs to identify gaps in coverage, quality, and usability.

  • Work with large-scale data while championing privacy and compliance.
  • Engage with customers and internal teams to identify pain points and drive impactful improvements.
  • Stay engaged with the latest research and foster a strong applied science culture. Publishing is encouraged.

  • 4+ years of experience in predictive analytics, statistics, or research.
  • Experience with synthetic data generation and data management for evaluation/training.
  • At least one year of experience publishing patents or peer-reviewed papers.
  • Deep motivation for user-centric AI and interest in human cognition, memory, and AI.
  • Global collaboration is integral to our work at Microsoft, and proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with reinforcement learning and distributed computing platforms (e.g., Heron, AML, Euclid).

  • DevOps experience and cloud services knowledge (Azure preferred).

title: Senior Software Engineer (Lending)
description:
About the Role

You will work closely with the product and credit teams to build go-to-market functions for our lending decisioning engine. You’ll debug and resolve complex issues independently, anticipate potential blockers, and help unblock others when needed.

You will evaluate scope and requirements critically by surfacing ambiguities early, challenging assumptions, and reframing trade-offs to ensure clarity before execution. Progress, risks, and blockers should be communicated proactively through tickets, stand-ups, and async updates to keep teammates and stakeholders aligned.

You will provide detailed peer reviews that improve code quality, maintainability, and extensibility. In addition, you’ll drive continuous improvement by identifying technical debt, proposing design or tooling enhancements, and sharing best practices that increase team velocity and reliability.

About the Team

The team develops Clutch's real-time lending decisioning engine. We work closely with Credit, Product, and Implementation teams to increase auto-decision rates and reduce funding time for our credit union partners. The team operates with a clear cadence and shared rituals, using narrative-driven planning and continuous improvement to ship reliably while collaborating across the broader Lending org.

Engineers own outcomes end to end, from discovery and decision-ready specs through rollout, monitoring, and follow-ups.

What You’ll Do

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Debug and resolve issues independently, providing clear root-cause analysis and documenting learnings.

  • Take ownership of smaller features end-to-end, from clarifying requirements to deployment.

  • Build working knowledge of decisioning engine features and rules, being able to explain their impact on the product.

  • Proactively ask questions, surface risks, and challenge assumptions early to improve clarity and scope of work.

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Drive predictable delivery by proactively communicating progress, risks, and blockers without being prompted.

  • Confidently operate on lending decisioning context, making informed tradeoffs and documenting decisions.

  • Lead technical implementation for a feature or partner go-live, coordinating with stakeholders for alignment.

  • Anticipate potential problems in requirements or design, reframing them with data and alternative solutions before they become blockers.

  • Contribute high-quality code reviews that not only ensure standards, but also provide mentorship and elevate peers’ design and coding practices.

Within 9 months, you will:

  • Lead and deliver a small-to-medium scoped project independently, including technical design, planning, and rollout.

  • Build trust with cross-functional and external stakeholders by representing engineering context and constraints clearly.

  • Proactively identify technical debt or process gaps and drive initiatives to resolve them with measurable impact.

  • Demonstrate readiness for the next level by consistently owning delivery, influencing peers, and shaping team practices that raise the overall bar.

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong product-oriented mindset, able to connect technical decisions with business impact.

  • Proven ability to debug and resolve complex issues independently, providing clear root-cause analysis and documenting learnings.

  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Credit, Implementation, and external stakeholders to align on scope and trade-offs.

  • Consistent ownership of small-to-medium projects end-to-end, from discovery and design to deployment and follow-up.

  • Ability to critically evaluate requirements, anticipate risks, and propose pragmatic alternatives that improve clarity and delivery outcomes.

  • Advanced English skills, both spoken and written.

  • Plus: previous experience with loan origination systems is a strong differentiator.

Please note that this role may evolve as our business needs change, so we appreciate your flexibility and adaptability.

What’s In It For You?

  • Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of remote work from anywhere, balancing life and career seamlessly.

  • Unforgettable Off-Sites: Twice a year, bond with colleagues in exciting destinations, fostering teamwork and fresh ideas.

  • Paid Time Off and National Holidays: Enjoy 20 PTO days yearly and the National Holidays for relaxation and rejuvenation.

  • Stock Options: Joining us means having a stake in our success, so you'll receive stock options as part of your compensation package.

  • Home Office Setup: Create your ideal workspace with a dedicated budget for home office essentials.

  • Work Trip Budget: Grow personally and professionally with a budget for work-related trips and co-working.

About Us

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, proudly backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aimed at revolutionizing the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. As a champion of financial well-being, we address the urgent need for affordable lending solutions in an era where the average American grapples with over $155,000 in household debt. Unlike traditional financial institutions, Clutch develops software to turn Credit Unions into FinTech lenders and leverage their balance sheets to responsibly lend to over 130M Americans. Our mission extends beyond mere financial transactions; we strive to fundamentally enhance the way credit unions interact with their members. By integrating cutting-edge technologies and user-centric designs, we help credit unions provide seamless digital experiences that are on par with leading tech companies. This approach not only preserves but revitalizes the longstanding tradition of community and member-focused service inherent to credit unions.

Please note: This position is offered on a contractor basis. Applicants must have the necessary documentation and authorization to work in the country where the job is located. Clutch cannot provide sponsorship or assist with obtaining work permits for this role.

That said, during the interview process, we want to hear your thoughts. Please approach interviews without the use of AI tools—our goal is to get to know how you think, solve problems, and communicate. Once you're in the seat, bring on the prompts!

description:

In this role, you will be at the forefront of embedding intelligent AI-powered agents into Salesforce environments, enhancing customer interactions, automating complex business processes, and optimizing user experiences. You will partner closely with customers, internal account teams, product experts, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex business needs into AI-driven Salesforce agents that deliver tangible, measurable business outcomes. You will analyze requirements, design and implement intelligent Agentforce-powered agents within Salesforce, and continuously optimize the experience & performance to drive business value and consumption. The ideal candidate is customer-focused, self-driven, and excels in communication and collaboration. They should enjoy building relationships and quickly adapting to new technologies. This role suits individuals with strong technical skills who want to grow their careers at Salesforce and work with autonomous agent technologies. They will be the primary contact for helping customers activate, use, and expand Agentforce in their organizations.

Responsibilities

  • Assess technical and business readiness and map organizational processes through direct customer engagement
  • Lead the end-to-end design, configuration, and deployment of Agentforce agents within Salesforce; building agents that meet compliance requirements, business logic, and customer experience goals
  • Recommend opportunities to reengineer processes by combining AI agent capabilities with Salesforce automation tools such as Flows and OmniStudio.
  • Identify and provide recommendations on data strategy, data quality, governance (e.g., legal reviews, AI council), and software development lifecycle best practices.

  • Implement and configure leading large language models (LLMs) like GPT-4 for Salesforce agents

  • Track performance metrics and user feedback; execute iterative improvements based on performance metrics to grow Agentforce consumption
  • Build and maintain knowledge bases and technical documentation for internal and customer use
  • Develop and implement standardized agent deployment processes; create and maintain integration patterns across Salesforce platforms
  • Deliver guidance on best practices to ensure customers can self-sustain their Agentforce implementation.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills with demonstrated ability to communicate and influence effectively at all levels of the organization, including executive and C-level
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts in business-friendly terms to customers, then explain customer needs to internal partners.

Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years experience with cloud based technologies and architecture principles
  • Advanced or expert knowledge of Salesforce and Agentforce and AI
  • Experienced with Data Cloud or similar data integration platforms
  • Other Salesforce Certs such as Advanced Admin, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Agentforce, or Sales Cloud
  • Solid understanding of AI concepts, especially conversational AI or intelligent agents.
  • Hands-on experience integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) or AI services into applications
  • Experience with AI orchestration frameworks or prompt engineering
  • Consistent proactive thinking and the desire to self-start on learning and applying new technologies.
  • Ability to design scalable solutions for complex business requirements.
  • Skilled in debugging, optimizing, and ensuring the reliability of integrated AI-Salesforce solutions.
  • Strong proficiency in Salesforce Flow, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Apex, Salesforce APIs, and Agent Studio
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, ensuring minimal disruption to client operations.
  • Document technical processes, develop proofs of concept, and participate in Agile project planning.
  • Advise on best practices for application development, integration, and technical architecture.

The world’s largest banks, processors, and retailers trust Feedzai to protect trillions of dollars and manage risk while improving the customer experience for everyday users, without compromising privacy. Feedzai is a Series D company and has raised $282M to date. With a valuation of +$1.5B, the company's technology protects 900 million people in 190 countries.

You:

Feedzai is looking for an Engagement Manager/Business Analyst who has strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills and demonstrates a strong passion for client success and product adoption. This role will serve as the leader for the delivery of the Order Form for our customers, which will include milestones such as defining the scope, stakeholder identification, data dictionary definition, and more.
You will combine product expertise with business acumen and general project management skills to lead the client through the implementation phase of each project. Being the client's primary point of contact, you should be able to coordinate multiple priorities and ensure the client can overcome any obstacles during the implementation process. You should continuously grow your professional skills through training, self-development, and by successfully guiding clients in integrating Feedzai’s products to prevent financial crime.

Your Day to Day:

  • Act as the primary point of contact for Feedzai’s customers and foster positive relationships with them;
  • Identify each client’s expectations and requirements and effectively communicate them across functional teams;
  • Become a subject matter expert of Feedzai’s products and advise clients about best practices;
  • Collaborate with the client with the support of Data Science and Risk Analyst teams to map the client’s fields to Feedzai’s standard API data dictionary;
  • Design process flows with an understanding of the customer’s event flow and current state;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams in a multicultural environment;
  • Address customer issues with speed and efficiency;
  • Perform project management tasks such as communicating the project status to both internal and external stakeholders, reminding clients about implementation milestones along with their due dates, facilitating meetings, taking meeting notes, and leading the product activation from start to finish;
  • Work with the portfolio manager to manage client backlog and understand client timelines;
  • Define and assess project risks and effectively devise mitigation plans;
  • Provide updates to internal cross-functional partners (Product Management, Product Development, Portfolio Managers) on customer perspectives, risks, strategic insights, issue resolution activities, and expansion opportunities;
  • Collaborate with the product and software development teams to ensure customer feedback is incorporated into our product roadmap;
  • Translate technical client requirements into user stories to be consumed by the Engineering team for implementation.

You Have & You Know-how:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Management, Engineering or similar field;
  • At least 2 years experience in a Business Analyst role with responsibility for requirement elicitation;
  • Familiarity with API mapping and design;
  • Demonstrated skills in managing customer relationships for a managed services and/or SaaS organization;
  • Project management experience, including the ability to effectively prioritize different clients’ deliverables;
  • Experience being hands-on with leading Customer Onboarding and Implementations;
  • Experience with the full Standard Development Lifecycle (SDLC);
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills;
  • Leadership, adaptability, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills;
  • Be solution-oriented and take initiative when issues arise;
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills;
  • Ability to manage client expectations and push back when necessary;
  • Experience leading workshops and project initiation meetings;
  • Experience with Visio or similar flowcharting software;
  • Understanding of data/schema definitions such as JSON and XML.

Your First 30-Days at Feedzai:

You will be immersed in our brand with training, connections, and one-on-one time with your manager. You may shadow your colleagues virtually or onsite at an office depending on where you work as you are supported through your Feedzai journey. In addition, you will have access to a ton of information to give you history, context, and all the knowledge you can handle about Feedzai and the team. Finally, you will start working on projects and collaborating on work currently being done. We can't wait to have you join the team!

Our culture and collaborative work environment are the keys to our success. Here you will work with the best in class global teams, earn a competitive salary and contribute to the largest digital transformations happening around the world.

What is in it for you?

At Netcracker, we are all entrepreneurs. This means we get creative when thinking of technical solutions, we explore possibilities and innovations and get excited about new technology. We take complete ownership of our roles and aren’t micromanaged or left feeling like just another number. The results we achieve are highly visible to our leadership team and we are recognized for our work and promoted accordingly.

Scope of this role

We are looking to hire a Release Engineer to join our growing company. This position will be part of our Engineering department based in our Sao Paolo office in Brazil. The role will maximize the engagement metrics of Netcracker’s digital properties, as well as the software release configurations according to Customers requirements for projects around the world. Role and responsibilities are:

  • Execute tracking and alignment of software components included on solution
  • Track component versions, branches and merges – GIT advanced user (GIT maintainer as a benefit)
  • Approve merges to the branch, including merge conflict’s resolution
  • Prepare release documentation: Release Notes, Proof of tests, installation notes
  • Track and manage the solution configuration
  • Ticket management
  • Maintain the CI/CD with the DevOps team assistance – Jenkins advanced user as a benefit
  • Run, monitor and do pipeline’s first triage
  • Involve respective teams to keep CI/CD green on daily basis as the POC
  • Change management (CRs & HF) - Coordination of new scope and fix issue plans
  • Managing the lifecycle of a change
  • Work with ITMSO on SIS plan build and validation
  • Prepare Production and non-Production environment’s update: communication plan, installation plan, roll-back plan and others as required
  • Run Production and non-Production environment’s update: HF/DF/Maintenance patch deployment
  • Manage deployment issues and troubleshooting
  • POC for Internal Release management, alignment of the installation plan with the stakeholders (Configuration / Environment support / Deployment Management / Solution delivery / Customer support)

Skills & Requirements

  • Release Planning and Coordination - Manage release schedules, timelines, and calendars;
  • Change Management – knowledge of change control processes, and governance, ITIL knowledge desired;
  • Documentation: Prepare release notes, rollback plans, and compliance reports;
  • CI/CD Understanding: Comprehend pipelines, branching strategies, and automated deployments (coding not required);
  • Environment and Configuration Management – Understand staging, pre-production and production environments;
  • Risk Management: Identify, evaluate, and mitigate release-related risks;
  • Scripting and Automation: Basic familiarity with Bash, PowerShell, or Python for effective communication with engineers;
  • Source Control Management – Knowledge on Git branching, merging, tagging, conflict resolution.

Soft Skills

  • Communication and Stakeholder Management – acting as a bridge between development, QA, operations, and business teams;
  • Conflict Resolution: Address and resolve disagreements between development and operations;
  • Leadership: Guide and coordinate cross-functional teams without direct formal authority;
  • Decision-Making Under Pressure: Confidently approve or stop releases in high-stakes scenarios;
  • Organization and Time Management: Prioritize and manage multiple releases while meeting SLAs;
  • Documentation Discipline: Maintain clear runbooks, deployment instructions, and troubleshooting guides;
  • Adaptability and Proactivity: Respond effectively to last-minute changes and identify opportunities for improvement;
  • Attention to Detail: Detect gaps in testing, approvals or dependencies before release;
  • Problem-Solving: Identify and address deployment failures or unexpected behaviors.

Education

THE COMPANY: Juul Labs has a mission to transition the world’s billion adult smokers away from combustible cigarettes, eliminate their use, and combat underage usage of our products. ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES: The Director, Cycle Planning is responsible for leading Juul Labs’ end-to-end commercial cycle planning process—translating strategic priorities into integrated, market-ready execution plans. This role ensures that product launches, promotions, consumer programs, and other commercial activities are strategically sequenced and operationally aligned to maximize business impact.

Reporting to the Sr. Director, Commercial Planning & PMO, the Director will partner with Sales, Brand, Go-to-Market (GTM), Demand Planning, and Operations to define objectives, set target metrics, and align tactical execution plans for each cycle. This includes managing dependencies, identifying risks and conflicts, and ensuring that all commercial activities are timed and resourced to deliver against volume, revenue, and market share goals. The Director will also serve as the central point of coordination for cycle planning inputs across the U.S. and International markets, ensuring integration with demand planning, resource allocation, and commercial governance processes.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the Commercial Cycle Planning Process
    • Own the development and management of JUUL Labs’ commercial cycle plans from strategy definition to execution readiness.
    • Partner with Commercial, Sales, and Brand leaders to set objectives, define KPIs, and prioritize activities within each cycle.
    • Integrate New Product Introductions (NPIs), promotions, and consumer programs into unified execution strategies that align with corporate and market priorities.
    • Maintain a forward-looking view of the cycle calendar to ensure proactive planning and risk mitigation.
  • Strategic Sequencing & Alignment
    • Facilitate cross-functional planning sessions to align activity sequencing for maximum commercial impact.
    • Identify and resolve conflicts, capacity constraints, and dependencies across initiatives.
    • Ensure cycle planning decisions consider operational lead times, regulatory requirements, and market readiness.
    • Partner with Demand Planning to ensure cycle strategies are supported by accurate forecasts and inventory availability.
  • Integration with Demand Planning & Governance

    • Collaborate with the demand planning team to align forecasts with cycle objectives and promotional plans.
    • Support the Sr. Director, Commercial Planning & PMO in preparing cycle planning updates for the Commercial Executive Team.
  • Planning Tools & Process Improvement
    • Maintain and evolve standardized cycle planning templates, tools, and workflows.
    • Drive process improvements to increase visibility, alignment, and execution efficiency across the commercial organization.
    • Partner with the PMO team to incorporate cycle planning milestones into initiative tracking dashboards.

PERSONAL AND PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 8+ years in commercial planning, marketing operations, or related commercial execution roles.
  • Proven experience managing integrated planning processes that span multiple functions and markets.
  • Strong facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and drive consensus.
  • Ability to manage complex calendars and dependencies across product launches, promotions, and market programs.
  • Experience in CPG, nicotine/tobacco, or other regulated industries.

Preferred:

  • Experience leading Cycle Planning efforts in a commercial organization
  • Familiarity with enterprise planning tools and demand planning systems.
  • Experience integrating commercial planning with S&OP processes.

title: Head of Recovery Strategy, Process and Programs
description:
About Upstart

Upstart is the leading AI lending marketplace partnering with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit. By leveraging Upstart's AI marketplace, Upstart-powered banks and credit unions can have higher approval rates and lower loss rates across races, ages, and genders, while delivering the digital-first lending experience their customers demand. More than 80% of borrowers are approved instantly, with zero documentation to upload.

Upstart is a digital-first company, which means that most Upstarters live and work anywhere in the United States. However, we also have offices in San Mateo, California; Columbus, Ohio; and Austin, Texas.

Most Upstarters join us because they connect with our mission of enabling access to effortless credit based on true risk. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Upstart, we’d love to hear from you!

The Team

The Recovery team at Upstart is responsible for maximizing post-default recoveries while ensuring compliant, borrower-centric engagement across a diverse and growing vendor ecosystem. As our Recovery operations mature, we are investing in building smarter, more scalable systems that reduce manual risk, improve data-driven decisions, and align our vendor network with long-term strategic outcomes.

We are seeking a Head of Recovery Strategy, Process & Programs to lead our transformation roadmap across vendor integration, automation, compliance infrastructure, and intelligent placement logic. This individual will work cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Data Analytics, and Operations to architect the next evolution of Recovery operations at Upstart.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Lead Recovery’s transformation roadmap: Design and deliver high-impact initiatives that reduce manual risk, automate vendor workflows, and scale internal process efficiency across legal recovery, bankruptcy, affidavits, DSC, debt sales, and probate.
  • Architect scalable vendor infrastructure: Enhance frameworks for vendor onboarding, integration, compliance scorecards, and audit-readiness, ensuring Recovery is built to scale intelligently across a growing multi-vendor ecosystem.
  • Quantify and optimize placement strategy: Partner with data analytics, ML, and operations to improve liquidation and cost-to-collect through segmentation logic, hypothesis-driven testing, and performance-based routing.
  • Drive analytical and cross-functional execution: Lead strategic programs from concept to implementation—including the rollout of tools like Convoke, legal collections testing, and compliance health models—grounded in measurable ROI and portfolio-level impact.
  • Own Recovery’s strategic alignment layer: Serve as the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, Legal, ML, and Ops to ensure programs are modeled, implemented, and monitored with discipline.
  • Enable performance & quality execution, not manage it: This is a high-ownership individual contributor role. You'll complement operational leadership by enabling managers with scalable tools, systems, and decision frameworks—not by running day-to-day vendor performance.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in product strategy, operations, or transformation program leadership in a regulated or financial services environment
  • Proven success leading analytically rigorous initiatives involving ROI modeling, hypothesis-driven testing, and cost-benefit analysis while leading complex, cross-functional initiatives involving vendors, risk/compliance, and technology teams
  • Demonstrated ability to estimate financial impact at the unit and portfolio level (e.g., revenue per transaction, net present value over time)
  • Demonstrated experience applying process design, automation, or analytics to solve operational problems
  • Excellent project management skills and the ability to organize and drive multiple workstreams
  • Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous problems, develop hypotheses, and present recommendations
  • Excellent communicator: able to synthesize complex analyses into clear, actionable roadmaps
  • Proven analytical skills, with the ability to monitor performance metrics and make data-driven decisions
  • Familiarity with compliance and operational risk frameworks in regulated financial operations
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a strong sense of urgency

Preferred Qualifications

  • Comfort building and interpreting unit economics models , breakeven analysis, and performance scenarios
  • Experience leading or collaborating on ML- or rule-based segmentation strategies for operational decisioning
  • Strong fluency with quantitative tools (SQL, Excel modeling, Looker, or scripting languages)
  • MBA from a top-tier business school
  • 3+ years of People management experience
  • Strong familiarity with regulated financial services operations or collections/recovery environments
  • Experience in legal collections, recovery optimization, debt sale analytics, or servicing vendor strategy
  • Immense curiosity about root causes—thinks critically from first principles and never stops asking questions
  • A natural thought-partner: open-minded, collaborative, and able to co-create new ideas with cross-functional teams
  • Experience working in fintech, financial services, or consulting (e.g. strategy, risk, vendor management)
  • Familiarity with tools like Convoke, Salesforce, AppScript, or vendor audit and control software
  • Experience with compliance, vendor due diligence, or regulatory exam preparation

Position location

This role is available in the following locations: Remote.

Time zone requirements

The team operates on the East/West coast time zones.

Travel requirements

As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

What you\'ll love

  • Competitive Compensation (base + bonus & equity)
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart
  • 401(k) with 100% company match up to $4,500 and immediate vesting and after-tax savings
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Generous holiday, vacation, sick and safety leave
  • Supportive parental, family care, and military leave programs
  • Annual wellness, technology & ergonomic reimbursement programs
  • Social activities including team events and onsites, all-company updates, employee resource groups (ERGs), and other interest groups such as book clubs, fitness, investing, and volunteering
  • Catered lunches + snacks & drinks when working in offices

title: Product Director, Feegow (100% remote-friendly within Brazil)

Company Description

Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group.

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step helping people live longer and healthier lives?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 50 million patients trust us every month. 300.000+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 12 years ago.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we\'re 100% remote-friendly.

Remote model: you can work 100% from home, but you are also welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.

Job Description

Feegow is the leading Practice Management System (PMS) in Brazil for individual doctors & large clinics alike, and a highly strategic product for Docplanner Group, as a foundation to conquer the Brazilian market.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Director of Product for Feegow to lead our product teams, drive innovation, accountability, and play a key role in our product\'s modernization. This is a remote-friendly role within Brazil, where you’ll foster collaboration between global teams, steer product development, and manage a talented product team. Your expertise in building a data-driven & business minded product culture whilst delivering fast & safe iterations, knowing when to go for PoCs & robust solutions based on the business appetite and product maturity will ensure the continued growth of Feegow and Docplanner Group.

What we expect from this position:

  • Inspire, lead and bring in PMS product vision to all product managers and teams.
  • Understand a complex environment where the teams have not only individual doctors and clinics that should be delighted with their Efficiency platform, whilst bringing them new value propositions like Visibility & Growth, as well as betting on AI as a door opener for exponential value.
  • Define with PMs the product strategy on every team, how it relates to the broader Brazilian strategy & Docplanner Tech & Product strategy.
  • Influence and establish a shared vision with other business areas as Sales, Operations and Marketing. Be a key stakeholder for Individuals and Clinics Business owners.
  • Ensure upcoming product needs and opportunities aligned with your Engineering Director and Country Managers to create a coherent Product & Tech Strategy and Roadmap.
  • Champion a hands-on approach to innovation by using a combination of Data, listening to the market, and “getting out of the building” to get first-hand customer/user insights.
  • Create a culture of decision-making based on insight, analysis and data across the business.
  • Work closely with our Global VP Product, on standardizing the objectives in clear indicators & tasks and bring transparency on ‘the plan’ across the whole company.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years’ work experience as Product Director / GPM (managing and coaching a group of Product Managers)
  • Experience on B2B SaaS scale-ups
  • Solid experience in fast high-growth environment, change management, & business growth
  • A proven track record of delivering significant success, scaling and developing high performing digital products that impact business & delight customers
  • Expertise in the end-to-end product development lifecycle, agile and lean software development practices
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding organizational, communicative and leadership skills
  • Business savvy, holistic business acumen outside of Product Management and ability to assess product market fit
  • Analytical abilities and problem-solving skills
  • Experience in healthcare is a plus not a must
  • Experience in modernizing tech debt whilst delivering product value is a plus
  • Hands-on: In Docplanner, being a people manager does not mean only managing people, but being able to dive in the details of problems, opportunities & solutions.

Additional Information

What will you get in return?

Let’s talk money

  • A salary adequate to your experience and skills between R$37,000and R$44.500. Your salary will be, now and always, 100% transparent to you;

Benefits:

  • 100% remote-friendly within Brazil
  • Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;
  • We have compensatory time off (Banco de Horas);
  • Food/Market Voucher;
  • Medical, Dental, and Group Life Insurance;
  • Pet Plan;
  • iFeel app, for emotional comfort;
  • Gympass for you and up to 3 people!
  • Creditas: Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment;
  • Stock Options- eligible after 6 months of employment (5 years grace period)
  • Birthday Day Off;
  • Daycare Assistance;
  • Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services;
  • Referral Program offers up to R$600 per person who stays with us for more than 6 months;
  • Leave of Absence/Time-off: in the event of the passing of loved ones, we offer 10 days off; if your pet passes away, we offer 2 days. Got married? 7 days of rest! Did the baby arrive? We offer 30 days for Dads and 6 months for Moms;

Important: Docplanner is an international English-first company. Therefore, please be sure to send your CV in English

We promote and embrace equal opportunities in our hiring process, and also every day at work. When you apply for our roles you receive equal treatment regardless of age, disabilities, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or parental status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or any other dimension of human difference. Faça parte do CNPEM!

No Centro Nacional de Pesquisa em Energia e Materiais (CNPEM), somos movidos pela paixão pela ciência. Nosso ambiente é um vibrante centro de pesquisa e desenvolvimento, onde profissionais de diversas especialidades se conectam para enfrentar desafios complexos e criar soluções para problemas relevantes, especialmente nas áreas de saúde, energia, materiais renováveis e sustentabilidade.

Somos uma Organização Social supervisionada pelo Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação (MCTI), na vanguarda da pesquisa científica no Brasil. Somos responsáveis pelo Sirius, a maior infraestrutura científica já construída no País, e atualmente, desenvolvemos o projeto Orion, um complexo laboratorial dedicado a pesquisas avançadas em patógenos, que estará disponível para a comunidade científica nacional e internacional.

Oferecemos uma ampla gama de oportunidades de carreira para profissionais de diferentes perfis. No CNPEM, conduzimos pesquisas de ponta que abrangem nanotecnologia, biociências, biotecnologia, biorrenováveis, instrumentação científica e física de aceleradores, conduzidas, respectivamente, pelos Laboratórios Nacionais de Nanotecnologia (LNNano), Biociências (LNBio), Biorrenováveis (LNBR) e Luz Síncrotron (LNLS). Essas iniciativas são fortalecidas por projetos tecnológicos desafiadores e pela busca de soluções na fronteira das engenharias, liderados pela Diretoria Adjunta de Tecnologia (DAT).

Todo esse ecossistema é sustentado por uma rede integrada de áreas estratégicas que inclui tecnologia da informação, comunicação, gestão de projetos, assessoria jurídica & compliance, recursos humanos, finanças, compras, sustentabilidade e inovação, alocadas entre Diretoria Geral (DG) e Diretoria de Serviços Compartilhados (DSC). A Diretoria Adjunta de Infraestrutura (DAI) assegura a manutenção das instalações, o suporte à engenharia e o desenvolvimento arquitetônico, criando condições ideais para o avanço de todas as atividades.

A Ilum Escola de Ciência complementa essas frentes com um curso de bacharelado em Ciência e Tecnologia, oferecendo uma formação inovadora que prepara novas gerações de cientistas para os desafios do futuro.

Acreditamos que o sucesso é alcançado por meio de dedicação, colaboração e propósito claro. Valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo dos nossos profissionais e estudantes, oferecendo um ambiente inspirador e favorável para o crescimento profissional e pessoal.

Estamos comprometidos com a sustentabilidade e buscamos soluções que promovam um futuro mais verde. Prezamos pelo cuidado e bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, ao mesmo tempo em que valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas e respeitadas.

Se você é apaixonado por ciência e busca um lugar onde você possa fazer a diferença, junte-se a nós no CNPEM.

title: Medical Specialist
description:
Overview

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we\'re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job Title

Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location

Remote

Employment Type

Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

Role and Responsibilities

  • We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master\'s or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences.
  • This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology.
  • Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model\'s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master\'s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.

  • Identify marketing activities that support growth initiatives on marketplace platforms
  • B. Account Management

  • C. Performance Analysis

  • Maintain pacing levels within monthly, quarterly, & annual budgets
  • E. Content Development

Comprehensive report outlining quarterly marketing strategies and budget allocations for respective countries and assigned accounts.

description:
Overview

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users\' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Responsibilities

  • Managing Google Ads Campaigns: Launch, monitor, and optimize campaigns across Search, Display, and Video.
  • Bottom-of-Funnel Focus: Prioritize conversions that go beyond lead generation, including SQLs, pipeline impact, and closed-won revenue.
  • Collaboration with Sales Teams: Partner closely with sales to align on lead quality, refine campaign targeting, and maintain a strong feedback loop.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting: Create dashboards and evaluate campaign results using Google Analytics, Looker Studio, and spreadsheets.
  • Full-Funnel & Lead Quality Insights: Deep knowledge of the buyer journey and how paid media influences progression through the funnel.
  • A/B Testing & Creative Iteration: Conduct A/B tests on targeting, ad creatives, landing pages, and bidding tactics to drive performance gains.
  • Cross-Channel Integration: Collaborate with the broader marketing team to maintain cohesive messaging and strategic alignment across all channels.
  • Landing Page & CRO Collaboration: Coordinate with design teams to enhance landing page effectiveness and improve conversion rates.
  • Budget Management & Forecasting: Manage spend pacing and performance targets, with clear reporting on ROI and CAC.
  • Platform Expansion: Research and experiment with emerging ad formats and placements within the Google Ads platform.

Experience we\'re looking for

  • Expertise in Google Ads: Over 5 years of hands-on experience managing paid campaigns across Google Search, Display, and Video.
  • Full-Funnel Focus: Skilled in tracking and optimizing campaigns beyond top-of-funnel leads, with an emphasis on driving revenue.
  • Strong Analytical Abilities: Proficiency in using Google Analytics, spreadsheets, Looker Studio (or similar tools), and analyzing campaign performance data.
  • Collaboration with Sales: Proven experience partnering with sales teams to enhance campaign impact on the sales pipeline.
  • Advanced Conversion Tracking: Knowledgeable in UTM parameters, pixel setup, and using Google Tag Manager for tracking.
  • Proficient in English: Effective in communicating and collaborating in English across teams and documentation.
  • CRM Awareness: Understanding of how paid media campaigns connect with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot.

What we’re looking for this role to achieve

  • Drive higher revenue attributed to marketing through Google Ads campaigns.
  • Enhance SQL rates and boost lead-to-deal conversions via paid media channels.
  • Develop a collaborative workflow with the sales team to assess and refine lead quality.
  • Lower cost per acquisition (CPA) while improving return on ad spend (ROAS) and customer acquisition cost (CAC) efficiency.
  • Expand a full-funnel paid media strategy aligned with customer purchasing behaviors.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

Location: Remote (U.S.-based) | Preferred: Florida | Travel: Moderate travel required to client sites, conferences, and ICF offices

About the Role

ICF is hiring State Growth Leads to join our Energy, Environment, and Infrastructure (EEI) Group and help expand our presence in the State and Local Government market across high-priority states. Our multidisciplinary teams serve clients across climate resilience, disaster recovery, energy efficiency, infrastructure, transportation, and environmental planning. This is an exciting time to join ICF, as public-sector funding for state and local climate and infrastructure solutions continues to grow.

As a State Growth Lead, you will drive proactive growth strategies in focused states. You’ll be responsible for building a robust pipeline, developing strategic relationships, and securing high-value contracts with government agencies. You will work closely with subject matter experts, proposal teams, marketing, and delivery staff to pursue opportunities that align with ICF’s core capabilities and values.

This is a high-impact role with autonomy, visibility, and the opportunity to shape how ICF partners with state and local agencies on some of the most pressing issues of our time.

Why you will love working here

  • Quality of life: Flexible workplace arrangements, work-life balance
  • Investment in you: Tuition reimbursement, access to professional development resources, 401k matching, Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Investment of the community: Donation matching, volunteer opportunities
  • And many, many more (Ask your recruiter for more details!)

What you will be doing

Month 1 Expectations

  • Understand ICF’s capabilities across Disaster Management (DM); Climate, Energy, and Transportation (CET); environmental planning (E&P); and Utility Programs and Services (UPS).
  • Learn ICF’s business development and capture management processes.
  • Meet with key leaders across BD, Delivery, and Marketing teams.
  • Build a landscape of your assigned state: agencies, priorities, funding flows, and recent awards.
  • In collaboration with delivery leads, identify initial pipeline targets and key client relationships.

First 6 Months Expectations

  • Build a qualified pipeline of at least $50M in identified or anticipated opportunities.
  • Actively lead at least five pursuits across your assigned region.
  • Develop win strategies and lead opportunity shaping efforts.
  • Attend relevant conferences, industry events, and client briefings.
  • Review competitive proposals.
  • Identify and negotiate teaming relationships with local partners or primes.
  • Actively engage with key ICF stakeholders across all four EEI lines of business.

12–18 Month Expectations

  • Close new business totaling $20M+ in contract value.
  • Contribute to statewide or regional growth strategy planning efforts.
  • Co-develop state-specific marketing campaigns with support from ICF’s marketing team.
  • Develop value propositions and pursuit playbooks for recurring opportunity types.
  • Champion cross-ICF collaboration and alignment between technical and BD teams.
  • Maintain accurate CRM updates, forecasts, and pursuit documentation.

Minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 10+ years of business development or capture experience in the public sector, preferably state and local markets.
  • 3+ years of experience using structured capture processes (e.g., Shipley, APMP, MEDPICC, etc.).

Preferred skills

  • Background in one or more of the following sectors: climate adaptation, disaster recovery, infrastructure, transportation, energy efficiency, or environmental consulting.
  • Track record of leading and winning pursuits of $10M+ in total contract value.
  • Demonstrated understanding of government funding and procurement cycles at the state and local level.
  • Experience working with or for a state agency, city government, or county government.
  • Master’s degree or professional certification (e.g., APMP, CPCM) preferred.
  • Familiarity with CRM and pipeline tools (e.g., Dynamics, Salesforce).

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future. We can only solve the world’s toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. Responsibilities

What we’re looking for this role to achieve

Modelo de trabalho: Presencial.

Empresa: CPFL Brasil – Uma empresa do Grupo CPFL Energia.

  • Ensino superior completo, preferencialmente em direito ou economia;
  • Necessária experiência com regulação e comercialização, com foco em geração e mercado livre de energia;
  • Necessário conhecimento aprofundado acerca do arcabouço legal/regulatório do Setor Elétrico;
  • Diferencial conhecimento de estrutura tarifária;
  • Necessário inglês avançado (utilização no dia a dia para reuniões e elaboração de apresentações);
  • Disponibilidade para atuar 100% presencial em Campinas/SP.

O seu dia a dia:

  • Monitorar continuamente alterações legais, infralegais e regulatórias, analisando documentos de ANEEL, MME, CCEE, ONS, EPE e agências estaduais, para identificar riscos e oportunidades para os negócios.
  • Realizar análises técnicas dos impactos regulatórios sobre ativos e produtos, utilizando modelos e dados setoriais, com o objetivo de propor ajustes e mitigadores, além de identificar oportunidades, quando houver.
  • Elaborar e revisar contribuições técnicas para participações públicas, assegurando alinhamento institucional e profundidade técnica dos argumentos.
  • Colaborar com a elaboração de manifestações e recursos administrativos, junto a órgãos reguladores, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos e a defesa dos interesses da empresa.
  • Analisar preços, encargos setoriais e projeções tarifárias, utilizando ferramentas analíticas para avaliar impactos no Ambiente de Contratação Livre (ACL).
  • Representar tecnicamente a empresa em fóruns, grupos de trabalho e associações setoriais, defendendo posicionamentos estratégicos e promovendo articulação institucional.
  • Analisar e propor ajustes regulatórios aplicáveis aos produtos de comercialização, com foco em competitividade, inovação e conformidade.
  • Interpretar normativos regulatórios aplicáveis a projetos de geração, incluindo temas de conexão e transmissão, para orientar áreas técnicas e jurídicas.
  • Contribuir com o planejamento estratégico regulatório do grupo, propondo ações e metas alinhadas à agenda institucional.
  • Apoiar áreas internas com pareceres regulatórios especializados, assegurando segurança jurídica e técnica nas decisões corporativas.
  • Desenvolver materiais executivos para alta liderança, traduzindo temas regulatórios complexos em linguagem acessível e estratégica.
  • Fortalecer o relacionamento com stakeholders estratégicos, atuando como referência técnica e institucional em temas regulatórios.

Informações Adicionais / O que esperamos de você:

  • Capacidade Técnica: Conhecimento da estrutura regulatória do setor elétrico e suas alterações, com foco nas regras de comercialização de energia no Brasil.
  • Análise Crítica: Habilidade para identificar riscos e oportunidades de negócios a partir das mudanças regulatórias, propondo e negociando melhorias na regulação do setor elétrico e nas regras de comercialização de energia.
  • Comunicação Eficaz: Competência para acompanhar publicações relevantes no DOU e pautas regulatórias nas Reuniões da Diretoria da ANEEL, além de representar os negócios não regulados do Grupo CPFL junto às autoridades competentes e associações de agentes de mercado.
  • Colaboração e Influência: Capacidade de suportar a construção de contribuições às consultas públicas, tomadas de subsídios e demais atos regulatórios relacionados ao Setor Elétrico, interagindo com a Diretoria Executiva do grupo CPFL e áreas internas clientes.
  • Proatividade e Inovação: Elaboração de estudos e pareceres regulatórios para diversas áreas dos negócios não regulados, clientes, fornecedores e públicos diversos, sempre buscando maximizar o resultado consolidado do Grupo CPFL.

O que oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Licença maternidade 6 meses e paternidade 20 dias
  • Auxílio creche (conforme regras de elegibilidade);
  • Wellhub;
  • Programa Fale Comigo (assessoria gratuita e sigilosa via telefone para auxílio psicológico, jurídico, financeiro, social).

Conheça um pouco sobre nós:

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.
